main_measure.name: mean excess forward 10-bar return on bars with forecast >= 10

statistic.name: t of the mean on non-overlapping 10-bar samples

main_measure.threshold: mean > 0 with t >= 2 confirms; mean < 0 with t <= -2 rejects; at least 30 non-overlapping cases

supporting_check.name: Spearman correlation of forecast vs forward 10-bar excess return on trending bars

decided_by: Confirm rule: mean excess 10-bar return after forecasts >= 10 is above 0 with t >= 2 and at least 30 non-overlapping cases.
reading: Situation checked on regime == 'trending' plus near_high raw range position > 0 with a positive forecast; the coin's mean 10-bar return is the mean of all its in-window forward 10-bar returns over all its windows; the mean uses all bars with forecast >= 10 while the t and the case count use the non-overlapping grid (positions 0, 10, 20, ... of each window).
